originals.ko: 나는 동의했어, 왜냐하면 그녀가 너무 바빴거든
originals.why: Natural North Welsh; the LEGO keeps the sense it has in this seed, 'she was too busy'.

originals.ko: 그녀는 너무 바빴지만 나는 할 수 있었어
originals.why: Leaving out the verb after 'medru' ('I could') is natural in spoken Welsh, and the LEGO keeps its sense from this seed.

originals.ko: 미안해, 하지만 그녀는 오늘 너무 바빴어
